verdict.rationale: Docs describe manual review tooling (review-tools.md) where reviewers can access collected images and extracted data, override the verification status to reflect their decision, and add documents to a blocklist — directly matching the described queue-plus-feedback workflow, backed by webhook/status-change notifications (handle-verification-outcomes.md) and programmatic access to verification results (access-verification-results.md). missing for 10: no explicit documentation of an automatic 'borderline' routing threshold or a dedicated review-queue UI, and no independent/hands-on account of reviewers using these tools in practice.
